auth.twoFactorOnHint: Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app after the password. If you lose the phone, use a recovery code or ask an administrator to reset it.

auth.twoFactorQrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

auth.recoveryCodesSaveFirst: Save or copy the codes first
auth.newRecoveryCodesHint: The old codes will stop working. Type a code from the app to continue.
auth.twoFactorOffConfirmHint: To turn it off, type your password and a code from the app (or a recovery code).
auth.passwordsDoNotMatch: The new passwords do not match.
auth.changeRequired: Welcome {{name}} — change your password before you continue (first sign-in, reset by an administrator, or expired).
auth.changeHint: Changing it signs out every other session of your account.
auth.switchFailed: Could not switch to that company.

security.mustChangePassword: Must change password at next sign-in
security.newUserHint: The new user gets these roles in the current company and access to it (all branches). Add companies and branches after saving.
security.resetTwoFactorConfirm: Turn off this user's two-step verification? They will sign in with the password alone until they turn it on again (e.g. after losing their phone).
security.rolesHint: A role without a branch covers the whole company. Changes apply when the user's session renews (within the session length).
security.scopesTitle: Companies and branches they can enter
security.scopesHint: Each row is a place the user can sign in to. The default one opens after sign-in.
security.resetHint: Every session of the user ends; they sign in with the new password.
security.rolesListHint: System and company administrators have full access. Other roles start with no permissions until you grant them.
security.name: Name
security.systemRoleHint: System roles keep their name and code — their permissions are set like any other role.
security.newRoleHint: Set its screens and fields after saving.
security.fullAccessHint: This role skips every permission check — all screens and all fields. There is nothing to set here.
security.deleteRoleConfirm: Delete this role? It must not be assigned to anyone.
security.screensHint: Any right besides View turns View on with it. Approve = post, approve, reject, cancel and reverse documents.
security.fieldsHint: An unrestricted field is visible and editable. A restricted one comes back empty when View is off, and keeps its stored value when Edit is off. Sensitive values are always hidden in the audit log.
security.fieldsScreenHint: The same field may show on one screen and be hidden on another — the rule here holds on the chosen screen only.
security.buttonsHint: A button without a custom rule follows the screen permission shown beside it. A custom rule decides on its own (as long as the role can view the screen), and each press is written to the audit log unless you switch that off.
security.uiOnlyHint: This button never calls the server on its own, so the permission only hides it.
security.sessionsHint: Every device signed in right now. Ending a session makes that device sign in again once its current session runs out (within the session length).
security.sessionMinutesHint: Renews by itself after that — role changes apply then
security.refreshDaysHint: Inactive this long means signing in again
security.retentionHint: The log is never edited or deleted. A daily job moves entries older than this to a separate archive (moved, not deleted).
